description: One-binary, portable GDAL CLI. Supports legacy EXE names (gdalinfo, gdal_translate, gdalwarp, ogr2ogr, ogrinfo, ...) plus the GDAL 3.12+ unified `gdal` CLI. After install, run `ezgdal install-applets` to expose legacy EXE-name symlinks. Native binaries for win-x64.
title: ezgdal — portable GDAL CLI
